text:
jamie: Observed tail latency spike after enabling CUTLASS INT4 path + KV-prefetch heuristic change. Dashboard: https://internal/perf/dash/INT4_PREFETCH
jamie: Spike affects short seqs (<64) on sm86 hosts; p99 goes from 28ms -> 75ms for chat_small model.
jamie: Enabled flags: --enable-cutlass-int4, --kv-prefetch=adaptive, build flags: -DUSE_CUTLASS_TUNED=1 -DARCH_DETECT=1
lee: Can you paste the hot kernel names from perf? also try disabling prefetching to see delta
jamie: Perf snippet:
```
CPU: 10% io wait
kernel::cutlass::int4_gemm            42.3%
kernel::triton::softmax              8.7%
kv_cache::apply_prefix_cache         22.1%
batcher::combine_small_requests      11.5%
other                                15.4%
```
jamie: Notice cutlass int4 dominates; but KV cache work also high. suspect prefetch causes extra memstreams for short sequences
noor: Hypothesis: when adaptive prefetch threshold low, small-batch requests trigger prefetch for each request leading to PCIe saturation -> tail. Try batching threshold=0.5 (was 0.2)
sophia: Also check arch detection: sm90 fallback disabled? If arch mis-detect chooses sm86 optimized kernel on sm90 hardware perf regresses
jamie: Re-ran with kv-prefetch=off and cutlass-int4 on: p99 drops to 32ms (good), throughput stable
lee: So prefetch combinated with int4 path bad. Need root cause: is cutlass int4 memory pattern more sensitive to PCIe concurrency? request trace shows many concurrent prefetches
perf-bot: Profiling capture uploaded: https://internal/artifacts/1968005432/trace.tar.gz
noor: Quick mitigations: revert adaptive prefetch default, add backpressure on parallel prefetches (limit 4 per GPU), and add experiment to run int4 vs int8 for short sequences
sophia: I'll open canary with prefetch-limit=4 + archdetect=strict on sm90 canaries
jamie: Patch idea: only prefetch when seq_len >= prefetch_min_seq AND batch_size >= prefetch_min_batch. propose prefetch_min_seq=64, prefetch_min_batch=4
lee: Also add perf-test to CI: synthetic load with seq=32 many concurrent clients to prevent regressions
jamie: I'll make PR with metric dashboards and the experiment plan. assigning to @noor and @sophia for canary rollout. :thumbsup:
noor: ack
sophia: ack, will coordinate canary windows and infra
jamie: leaving notes: logs to grab if it shows up: gpu_mem_bw, pci_retry, nvlink errors; and kernel launch concurrency counters
